title: Targeting macrophage JAK3/STAT3 signaling with tectochrysin: a novel therapeutic strategy to ameliorate bone erosion and synovitis in rheumatoid arthritis.
authors: Pan, Pin; Huang, Wei; Cheng, Shuyi; Hu, Lianying; Chu, Jianjun
journal: Journal of orthopaedic surgery and research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Tectochrysin通过抑制巨噬细胞JAK3/STAT3信号通路改善类风湿关节炎，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: This study aims to clarify whether Tectochrysin has a therapeutic effect on rheumatoid arthritis animal models and to explore the potential therapeutic mechanisms. METHODS: DBA mice were used to establish a collagen-induced arthritis mouse model. Then, we administered Tectochrysin via intragastric treatment at two doses of 5 mg/kg and 10 mg/kg. To evaluate the therapeutic effects, we assessed the clinical manifestations in mice, measured the levels of cytokines in mouse serum, performed pathological staining on knee and ankle joints, and analyzed bone destruction in knee and bone joints using micro-CT. Furthermore, combining molecular docking technology, we investigated the effects of Tectochrysin both in vitro and in vivo. In vitro experiments involved THP-1-induced macrophages, examining the impact of Tectochrysin on macrophages and CIA mouse peritoneal macrophages, as well as on JAK3 and STAT3 phosphorylation. We also analyzed the effects of Tectochrysin on the transcription levels of inflammatory factors in macrophages and on the migration of MH7A cells. RESULTS: Our study shows that Tectochrysin has a significant therapeutic effect on CIA mice. The clinical manifestations of CIA mice were alleviated after Tectochrysin administration, with reduced levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-1beta, IL-6, and TNF-alpha in the serum. Both the pathological staining of bone joints and the micro-CT results indicated less bone and cartilage damage in the Tectochrysin group. Additionally, Tectochrysin remarkably improved synovial hyperplasia and inflammatory cell infiltration in the joints of CIA mice.Molecular docking results revealed a more pronounced effect of Tectochrysin on JAK3. In both in vitro and vivo, Tectochrysin was found to inhibit the phosphorylation of JAK3 and STAT3, as well as the transcription of inflammatory cytokines in THP-1 derived macrophages. CONCLUSION: Tectochrysin may be a novel RA therapeutic agent, likely acting via macrophage JAK/STAT pathway inhibition, with promising clinical potential.
abstract_zh: 背景：本研究旨在明确Tectochrysin对类风湿关节炎动物模型是否具有治疗作用，并探讨其潜在治疗机制。方法：使用DBA小鼠建立胶原诱导性关节炎小鼠模型。随后，通过灌胃给予Tectochrysin，剂量分别为5 mg/kg和10 mg/kg。为评估治疗效果，我们观察了小鼠的临床表现，测量了小鼠血清中细胞因子水平，对膝关节和踝关节进行了病理染色，并使用micro-CT分析了膝关节和骨关节的骨破坏情况。此外，结合分子对接技术，我们研究了Tectochrysin在体外和体内的作用。体外实验涉及THP-1诱导的巨噬细胞，考察了Tectochrysin对巨噬细胞及CIA小鼠腹腔巨噬细胞的影响，以及对JAK3和STAT3磷酸化的作用。我们还分析了Tectochrysin对巨噬细胞炎症因子转录水平及MH7A细胞迁移的影响。结果：我们的研究表明，Tectochrysin对CIA小鼠具有显著的治疗效果。给予Tectochrysin后，CIA小鼠的临床表现得到缓解，血清中促炎细胞因子IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α水平降低。骨关节的病理染色和micro-CT结果均显示，Tectochrysin组的骨和软骨损伤较少。此外，Tectochrysin显著改善了CIA小鼠关节中的滑膜增生和炎症细胞浸润。分子对接结果显示，Tectochrysin对JAK3的作用更为显著。在体外和体内实验中，Tectochrysin均能抑制JAK3和STAT3的磷酸化，以及THP-1来源巨噬细胞中炎症细胞因子的转录。结论：Tectochrysin可能是一种新型的类风湿关节炎治疗药物，其作用机制可能通过抑制巨噬细胞JAK/STAT通路实现，具有潜在的临床应用前景。
